messages:
Nadia: Quick proposal: small-slice safety protocol for rolling out model_variant_v7. Goals: keep cold-starts low, enforce tenant opt-outs/blackouts, and automatic safe fallback chain. Need ops + SRE signoff.

Omar: Outline slices + prechecks? Also how Dedicated orgs opt-out?

Nadia: Plan: shadow 6h; slice A: 0.5% tenants in a low-traffic zone for 2h; slice B: 3% across two regions for 6h with 50% overlapping windows; slice C: 15% spread with A/B control for 12h. Ramp by +10% every 3h if gates pass. Dedicated orgs default OFF; org_override allowed with account-ops approval.

SRE-Teo: Rollback auto-triggers: p99 gen latency > 180ms for 5m; 5xx rate >= 0.6% over 5m; token-cost delta > +25% for 10m; hallucination signal spike by threshold. Circuit-breakers: per-node queue > 150 or GPU mem > 88% for 3m -> throttle. Sticky fallback chain: v7 -> v7-quant -> stable-v5, sticky 300s. If tenant has >3 fallbacks in 30m -> block 24h and page.

Omar: Pre-slice checks: validate no tenant in slice has blackout window or region_constraint; run priming 10m before start: ./scripts/prime.sh --tenant T --model v7 --samples 300, log to rollout ledger. Also synthetic probes 5m before slice.

Nadia: Flag payload example for ops: {"flag":"variant_v7_canary","scope":"tenant","tenants":["acme"],"pct":0.5,"regions":["eu-west"],"org_override":false,"region_constraint":null,"requires_kms":false}. Include sla_credit and blackout windows if needed.

SRE-Teo: Dashboards: per-tenant p95/p99, token-cost, fallback-count, blackout_exclusion_rate. Alerts: correlated latency+cost+fallback spike -> P1 and auto-ticket. Add routing-consistency probe every 60s; if mismatch >0.1% sampled tenants -> pause ramp.

Omar: A/B: ab-runner --control stable --variant v7 --min-samples 2500 --metrics latency,cost,hallucination_rate; require >95% data completeness before decision. Use overlapping windows to smooth cold starts.

Nadia: Owners: product=Nadia, eng-platform=Omar, ops=OpsTeam, oncall=SRE-Teo. Next steps: Omar to add pre-slice validator & flag API changes, Teo to stub alerts/runbook, OpsTeam to implement priming ledger and org_override workflow. Shiproom invite after PRs. :calendar:
